input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: The cap and the consequential-damages exclusion protect only Licensor, and the cap is one half of all amounts paid (well below 6 months' fees), while Licensee's liability is left unlimited and it "assumes all liabilities and risks" (p0029). There are no carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnities or IP infringement — Article XIII in fact disclaims Licensor liability for IP infringement. This is walk-away territory; we made the exclusion and cap mutual at 12 months' fees and added the Excluded Claims carve-outs.

input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless
input.rationale: The only indemnity runs from Licensee to Licensor and is very broad (any exercise of the licence, the conduct of our business), and Article XIII expressly negates any Licensor liability for IP infringement claims. There is no Vendor IP indemnity at all, which is our walk-away position; we inserted the standard Licensor defence/indemnity and carved it out of the exclusions.

input.quote: "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders.
input.rationale: No covenant restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build; the Field of Use provision is a scope limit on use of the Licensed Technology, not a non-compete, and we address grant scope under LICENSE. We note only that the field-of-use wording is narrow, which we would want confirmed against our intended FX activities.
